review_scope: All ten final responses, including malformed-contract replies, assessed against the full original seed. Mathematical content is assessed separately from visible format compliance. This is independent reviewer analysis, not formal proof, host acceptance or policy promotion.

source.review_copy_redactions: Supplied review IDs and prompt-ID redactions are opaque review-copy identifiers only; no participant identity error is inferred from redaction.

method.inputs: Only supplied blind packets, their original seeds and the source paper section 5.
method.finite_arithmetic: Direct independent substitution, matrix products and exact rational arithmetic; no runtime or frozen checking oracle invoked.
method.format: Visible contract structure inspected independently; this is not a reported host schema verdict.
method.outcome_repairs: None. No provider response or runtime was changed, repaired or promoted.
method.hint_scope: Next procedural hints are untested reviewer proposals with no fixture output values; private correction values elsewhere in this report must not be inserted into participant guidance.

status_definitions.yes: The obligation is supplied correctly within its explicitly limited scope; no broader proof claim follows.
status_definitions.partial: Useful correct content is supplied but the full obligation remains incomplete, unsupported or mixed with errors.
status_definitions.no: The required derivation/construction is absent, incorrect or contradicted.
status_definitions.CRITICAL_ERROR: An essential calculation, mathematical definition or claimed implication is incorrect.
status_definitions.INCOMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS: Useful substantial partial content is correct, but the full analytical goal is missing and some implications are misstated.

summary.format_observation: All ten use layout-description keys as literal response keys. Mathematical partial results remain reviewable independently of this common contract failure.
summary.nonclaim: No arm comparison, model conclusion, formal theorem certification or causal improvement claim is made from this blinded review.
